findings.title: Room Setup's Apply writes back every row it drew whose room the world changed since: a lock forced, repaired or breached while the window is open is undone by an Apply of another room, and a Repair the Lock under way is deleted
findings.surface: Room Setup - the frame (Apply), with the Doors, Rooms, Searching, Facilities and Description tabs' columns
findings.where: scripts/room-setup.mjs:963-1117 (applyRoomRows), 1358-1361 (the only keepFresh, the search-token setting)
findings.what_happens: readRoomSetupForm reads every row off the form as drawn at the open (537-560). applyRoomRows compares each row with the region's flags as they are when Apply is pressed (`before`, wasLocked, wasBroken, ... 987-1040), not with what the window drew, so a row the GM never touched differs as soon as the world changed that room, and the whole row is written: setRoomBroken with the drawn value (1042-1046) and, when it unticks, dropLockRepairs, which deletes every Repair the Lock project on that lock (doors-gm.mjs:307-319); writeRoomLock with the drawn lock (1111); setVaultRoom with the drawn owner, table, description and picture (1052-1060); the rest flags, the seal, No privacy, the mark and the neighbours. Nothing redraws those cells while the window is open: keepFresh watches the search-token setting alone. The same class of fault was fixed for the Fog boxes (ROOM-01, fog.mjs:1529-1540) and the stash cells (E89 C7, room-setup.mjs:1128-1135) by acting only where the GM changed a cell against what was drawn; the row columns were not.
findings.failure_scenario: During Daily Life the GM keeps Room Setup open (its own comment at 1343-1348 says that is when it is open); a player forces the Kitchen's door (doors-gm.mjs:175 setRoomBroken) and starts nothing yet, another player starts a Repair the Lock on it; the GM types a description for the Library and presses Apply - the Kitchen's lock is mended without a word to the GM about the force, the Repair project is deleted with only the 'dropped' whisper, and the players' break is gone.
findings.expected: a row's column written only where the GM changed it against what the window drew (as the Fog boxes and stash cells are), or the cells redrawn when the regions change
